pictures.author: Саид-Эми Кайсаров
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×720 daylight exterior. Four slender pale minarets with three projecting balconies and dark pointed caps; pink-beige walls with pale arched trim, central grey dome over lower half-domes, corner roof turrets and rows of smaller grey roof domes. Trees, lamps, flags, street furniture and city towers remain outside the asset.

pictures.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×640 courtyard view. Open paved court with pointed arcades on pale stone columns, alternating pink/cream arch wedges, grey cap domes and small gold finials. A central domed gate has a through passage, lattice side panels and slim capped corner turrets. Wet paving reflections and fine ornamental motifs are not copied into textures.
